method: R1 blind suread (subagent read text only, no md/rules)

facts.fact: 她讲完时，光线已倾斜成橙色。
facts.anchor: When she finishes, the light has slanted and taken on an orange hue.

facts.fact: Colm 全程专注倾听，随着她讲述越发静止。
facts.anchor: Colm watched her raptly throughout everything, growing more and more still as she spoke.

facts.fact: Colm 说有时他怀疑有人构陷 Tommy，但他不愿那是真的。
facts.anchor: I wondered sometimes if someone did this to him.

facts.fact: Colm 主张把事情交给当局，搜查 Dustin 的房子。
facts.anchor: We have to bring this to the authorities.

facts.fact: Hattie 指出没有确凿证据证明 Dustin 是 Bedfellow，照片和接近案发地只是间接证据。
facts.anchor: There’s no real evidence Dustin’s the Bedfellow.

facts.fact: Hattie 说证据已被销毁、无记录且 Ramsby 已死，没有 DNA 就没有案子。
Hattie 表示他们有一个计划。
Hattie 前一晚为 Tommy 剪了头发、修了胡子；Tommy 出现在厨房桌旁。
facts.anchor: She cut his hair the night before and trimmed his beard

facts.fact: Colm 上前将 Tommy 拥入怀中，两人站在八年边缘。
facts.anchor: Colm wavers in place, then rushes forward and sweeps Tommy into a hug.
